issues.description: Duplicate React imports in step-3/page.tsx causing build failure. Line 2 has `import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'` and line 3 has `import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react'`. This causes a compile error that blocks the entire app including the auth page.
issues.root_cause: Two separate import statements from 'react' exist in the file - the first imports useState and useEffect, the second imports useState, useEffect, useCallback, and useRef. SWC compiler does not allow duplicate named imports.

fixes.old_str:
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.new_str: import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: Remove the duplicate partial import on line 2, keeping only the complete import on line 3 which includes all needed hooks (useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef).
